_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ir shpilt Klondike Solitaire. Ayer tsil iz tsuriktsien ale kartn tsu di fondatsye haypen.

Shpil regeln:
- Fondatsye haypen (F1-F4): Bauen oyf fun Ace tsu King in kolir
- Tabel haypen (T1-T7): Bauen arop alternativ kolirn (royt af shvarts, shvarts af royt)
- Stok: Tsien kartn tsu vayt-pile
- Vayt (W): Di oberste kartn iz barayt far shpil

Komandn:
- 'tsien' - Tsien kartn fun stok tsu vayt
- 'riren <kval> <tsil> [count]' - Riren kartn tsivishn haypen
  Ekzempeln: 'riren W T1', 'riren T1 F2', 'riren T3 T5 2'. Di tsahl ken oykh zayn 'ale', vos vet probirn tsuriktsien ale ongedekte kartn.
- 'farliren' - Endn di shpil onmiten un shlosn ayer aktueln balmel
- Haypn nemen: W (vayt), F1-F4 (fondatsyes), T1-T7 (tabel)

Ir ken eksekutern mehredike aktsyes in ayn tur durkh tsaytn mit komyen:
  Ekzempel: 'tsien, riren W T1, riren T2 F1'

Narishkeyt ken nor vayzn zikh af leydike tabel haypen.
Aktsyes eksekutern in ordn - ven eyns feylt, di ibergibene aktsyes vern ibergegangen.
Nutzen 'farliren' ven ir gaybn, az di shpil iz onmeglikh tsu gayn.
